value.rationale: Proposition 2.5 is a general construction theorem intended to preserve woven K-fusion structure under every bounded operator. The counterexample breaks the conclusion in the strongest upper-bound sense while retaining closed operator range and closed image subspaces. It exposes a fusion-specific information loss: scalar amplitudes in K e_i disappear when one keeps only K W_i. This directly identifies the missing Bessel-control hypothesis needed for a valid construction.
